summary.headline: Dreamfolks Q2 FY27 revenue fell to INR 31.1 crore (from INR 39.0 crore in Q1) while adjusted EBITDA loss narrowed to INR 8.8 crore.
summary.overview: Q2 FY27 revenue was INR 31.1 crore versus INR 39.0 crore in Q1 FY27 and INR 205.5 crore in Q2 FY26, a steep year-on-year decline. Adjusted EBITDA improved to negative INR 8.8 crore from negative INR 16.4 crore in Q1, helped by the absence of the one-time upfront minimum guarantee paid in Q1 for global lounge expansion. Management highlighted the return to positive gross profit, an 8.7% gross profit margin for H1 FY27, and non-airport-lounge services contributing more than one-third of topline. Net worth declined to INR 290.1 crore from INR 313.8 crore at March 2026, while liquid balances rose to INR 187.8 crore.

segments.name: Non-airport-lounge services (Golf, Railway lounges, lifestyle)
segments.commentary: Contributed more than one-third of topline in Q2 FY27, per management. No segment-level revenue figures were given.

segments.name: Global lounges
segments.commentary: Network of more than 1,100 lounges; management aims to convert reach into programme activity and transaction volumes, with South-East Asia cited as encouraging. No figures disclosed.

segments.name: Railway lounges (Ten11 Hospitality subsidiary)
segments.commentary: Company owns and operates railway lounges in Chennai, Mumbai and Vadodara via Ten11; added a new railway lounge at Nashik in the quarter. Covers 100% of railway lounges in India through its network.

segments.name: Lifestyle and clubs (DF Club, Nagavalli Estate)
segments.commentary: DF Club Membership is live on several major bank loyalty platforms. Nagavalli Wilderness Estate (about 30 acres, 25-acre golf course, 37 cottages: 20 luxury and 17 eco) launched; no revenue disclosed.

guidance_outlook: No numerical guidance was given for revenue, margins or EBITDA for FY27.

Stated FY27 priorities: deepen distribution and adoption of launched services, drive programme activity across global lounges, scale railway business via Ten11, and expand lifestyle offerings through banking and loyalty partners.
Management intends to keep investing in technology and operating capabilities while focusing on improving contribution, revenue absorption and disciplined capital allocation.
Capex to be phased where appropriate and investment pace aligned with business development, per CFO.
capex_capacity: Railway lounges: company is evaluating further opportunities to expand direct operated presence through Ten11, focusing on operational control and service quality.
New railway lounge added at Nashik in Q2 FY27; current owned and operated lounges are in Chennai, Mumbai and Vadodara.
Nagavalli Wilderness Estate launched on the Odisha-Andhra Pradesh border: about 30 acres, 25-acre golf course, 37 cottages (20 luxury, 17 eco), spa, pool and restaurant.
Global lounge network above 1,100 lounges; one-time upfront minimum guarantee paid in Q1 FY27 to support global lounge expansion, no similar payment in Q2.
CFO said capex is being phased where appropriate; no capex amount disclosed.
demand_pricing: Banks and card networks showing growing interest in lifestyle and travel benefits beyond lounges: Coffee BOGO, members-only club access, Flight Cancellation for Any Reason (with Mastercard).
Partnerships announced at Global Fintech Fest (September 2026): Elixir wellness credit card (premium spa benefit), The Card Company premium prepaid metal card on RuPay (RBI-licensed PPI issuer).
Newer ultra-premium services being curated for affluent credit card customers; no launch timing given.
Management attributed Q2 operating conditions to ongoing geopolitical challenges; no pricing or realisation data disclosed.

qa_highlights.question: Moderator announced the first question from Sebin Joy (individual investor).
qa_highlights.answer: No question was heard; the line did not connect and the moderator closed the Q&A and handed over to management for closing comments.

risks_watch: Revenue fell to INR 31.1 crore in Q2 FY27 from INR 205.5 crore in Q2 FY26; the year-on-year comparison reflects a much larger prior base that management did not explain in the call.
Net worth fell by about INR 23.7 crore in H1 FY27, consistent with the H1 loss of INR 24.6 crore.
Adjusted EBITDA remains negative (INR 8.8 crore in Q2), so the return to positive gross profit has not yet reached operating breakeven.
Watch whether non-airport-lounge services keep above one-third of revenue and whether the 8.7% H1 gross margin improves.
Watch the pace of Ten11 railway lounge expansion and the cost of direct operations.
Watch bank loyalty-platform uptake of DF Club and conversion of global lounge network into transaction volumes.
summary.management_tone: Confident on strategic direction and partnerships, but measured on financials: management called Q2 steady progress "considering the ongoing geopolitical challenges" and gave no numerical guidance. The CFO's remarks stressed liquidity discipline and phasing capex. The call had no Q&A because the only analyst line failed to connect, so management did not address the sharp year-on-year revenue decline.
key_quotes: An encouraging development during the quarter was the return to positive Gross Profit, taking the Gross Profit margin to 8.7% for H1 FY27.
We continue to manage our liquidity prudently, with a focus on aligning the pace of investment with business development.
Q2 was a quarter of steady progress across several important areas of our business, considering the ongoing geopolitical challenges.
